flows.title: Add a Finish Action to a link, file, form or list email
steps: Open the redirect link, hosted file, form handler or list email you want the action to run from.
Go to its Finish Actions tab and click Add Finish Action.

Give the action a name and set the criteria that decide when it runs. The actions are the same library Journeys uses, such as adding the Prospect to a list, adjusting their score or assigning an owner.
Click Save. Finish Actions do not expire: one attached to an old email fires whenever that email is opened, even months later.

flows.title: Limit which events start an AppConnect recipe
steps: In AppConnect, create a new recipe, then create a new trigger and select an object, such as a new Insightly Contact.
Enable the Set Trigger condition toggle and add a field to the Trigger data field — for example, to process only Contacts from California.
Add further conditions with +, choosing OR or AND. From the third condition on, the operator already selected applies to all of them.

Write values exactly: they are case sensitive. Conditions are applied after events are fetched and check a record's state rather than a change, so a new-Contact trigger never picks up a Contact that is later updated to match.
